dedupe_against_earlier_work.note_on_AF1: QB1 uses the same on/off rule shape as AF1 (round 3) on a different data source. It is a new counted trial; it is not a re-test of AF1, and AF1's S1 result is not used to set any parameter here (rule copied from the AF1 prereg written before AF1's result).

scope: DEV only. No criteria change. A DEV_PROMISING flag only leads to a report to the user.
universe: traded legs are USDT-M perps of ADR 0047 U50 (cut-off bar i-2); COIN-M series are signals only

segments.rebalance: every 14 days on the Monday grid; trade at open of day i; weights drift; real funding
segments.BTCUSDT: not read in S2; BTCUSD COIN-M series also not used in S2 (and not used at all in the signals below)

definitions.quarterly_basis: for base X at day d: the COIN-M quarterly contract XUSD_YYMMDD with the nearest expiry more than 14 days after d; basis_ann = (quarterly close / XUSD_PERP close - 1) * 365 / days to expiry (expiry day from the contract name, 08:00 UTC)
definitions.cm_usd_volume: COIN-M kline column 7 (base asset volume) * close

trials.QB1_QBASIS_TIMING_U50: B = median basis_ann over ETH and alts with a quarterly series at cut (>= 4 names); long all U50 names equally (gross 1) when B[cut] <= median of B over cut-179..cut (>= 120 days), else flat
trials.QB2_QBASIS_XS: cross-section of the bases with a quarterly series that are also in U50 at the rebalance (ETH included): 7-day mean basis_ann; K = floor(n/3), n >= 6; long the LOWEST K, short the HIGHEST K, equal weight 1/(2K)
trials.CM1_CMSHARE_LEVEL_U50: ln(sum cm_usd_volume cut-27..cut / sum USDT-M quote volume cut-27..cut) for U50 names with a XUSD_PERP (>= 20 days); K = floor(n/5), n >= 10; long the HIGHEST share
trials.CM2_CMSHARE_CHANGE_U50: mean daily ln share over cut-6..cut minus over cut-34..cut-7 (>= 5 / >= 20 days); same K rule; long the HIGHEST

cost: ADR 0041 calibrated cost 'cal' on the USDT-M legs decides; cal_x2, cal_tail_x2 conditions; cost0 reference
decision_rule: identical to ADR 0094/0096-0099; DSR N=4 and cumulative N, PBO CSCV-16 over the 4 S1 series reported
power_note_written_before_results: about 58 S1 rebalances over 2.2 years; MDE at 80% (Bonferroni 0.05/4) about 2.1; QB2 has only 6-10 names (2-3 per side)
after_result: Variants are new trials needing a new prereg. Trial count +4 regardless.
